test_title: PYST 185: SSC GD Constable - English (Held On - 26th Nov,, 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneously spelt word is '**comunity**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**comunity**'.
 
• Its correct spelling is '**community**'.
 
• It means 'all the people who live in a particular place, area, etc. when considered as a group'. (एक समूह के रूप में संगठित स्‍थान-विशेष के समस्‍त निवासी; समुदाय)
 
 
• *Example: Recent increases in crime have disturbed the whole **community**.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of other words:

 
 
• **Exclaim**: to say something suddenly and loudly because you are surprised, angry, etc. (भावावेश में अचानक चिल्‍लाकर कुछ कहना)
 
• **Express**: to show something such as a feeling or an opinion by words or actions. (भाव या विचार को शब्‍दों या कार्यों द्वारा व्‍यक्त करना; अभिव्‍यक्त करना)
 
• **Array**: a large collection of things, especially one that is impressive and is seen by other people. (वस्‍तुओं का बड़ा संग्रह, विशेषतः प्रभावशाली प्रदर्शन के लिए) 
 
 

42:T7d1,

The correct answer is '**most**'.
